name: Create app
description: Create app Creates an app. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps
Creates an app. The returned `id` is used in all subsequent flag, changelog, and evaluation requests.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; body (body)

name: Create flag
description: Create flag Creates a flag. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}/flags
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}/flags
Creates a flag. Returns 409 if the key already exists. `type` is always inferred from variation values; legacy request-side values are ignored.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; app_id (path) — App identifier.; body (body)

name: Delete app
description: Delete app Deletes an app and all its flags and changelog history. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}

name: Delete flag
description: Delete flag Deletes a flag permanently. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}/flags/{flag_key}

name: Evaluate flag
description: Evaluate flag Evaluates a flag against the provided context. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}/evaluate
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}/evaluate
Evaluates a flag against the provided context. Pass context attributes as query parameters; values are forwarded as strings. For low-latency in-Worker evaluation, prefer the Flagship binding over this endpoint.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; app_id (path) — App identifier.; flagKey (query) — The flag key to evaluate.
Optional: targetingKey (query) — Context targeting key (per OpenFeature spec); used for percentage rollout bucketing.

name: Evaluate flag (POST)
description: Evaluate flag (POST) Evaluates a flag against the provided context, passed as a JSON request body (OFREP-shaped) rather than query parameters. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}/evaluate
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}/evaluate
Evaluates a flag against the provided context, passed as a JSON request body (OFREP-shaped) rather than query parameters. Returns the same response shape as the GET variant.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; app_id (path) — App identifier.; body (body)

name: Get app
description: Get app Returns an app's name and audit fields. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}

name: Get flag definitions
description: Get flag definitions Returns an app's evaluation-only flag definitions for SDKs that evaluate locally. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}/definitions
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}/definitions
Returns an app's evaluation-only flag definitions for SDKs that evaluate locally. Send the returned `ETag` in `If-None-Match` to avoid downloading unchanged definitions.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; app_id (path) — App identifier.
Optional: If-None-Match (header) — Previously returned ETag, or `*`.

name: Get flag
description: Get flag Returns the full flag definition including rules, variations, and audit fields. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}/flags/{flag_key}

name: Get flag changelog
description: Get flag changelog Returns the audit history for a flag, newest first. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}/flags/{flag_key}/changelog
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}/flags/{flag_key}/changelog
Returns the audit history for a flag, newest first. Each entry includes the event type and full flag state after the change; `update` entries include a field-level diff. Capped at 200 entries per flag.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; app_id (path) — App identifier.; flag_key (path) — Flag key (slug).
Optional: limit (query) — Max items to return (1–200).; cursor (query) — Pagination cursor from a previous response.

name: List apps
description: List apps Lists all apps in the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps
Lists all apps in the account. Returns identity and audit fields only — flag definitions are not included.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.

name: List flags
description: List flags Lists an app's flags ordered by key. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}/flags
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}/flags
Lists an app's flags ordered by key. Pass `cursor` from `result_info` to page forward; a null cursor indicates the last page.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; app_id (path) — App identifier.
Optional: limit (query) — Max items to return (1–200).; cursor (query) — Pagination cursor from a previous response.

name: Update app
description: Update app Updates an app. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}

name: Update flag
description: Update flag Replaces the entire flag definition. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/flagship/apps/{app_id}/flags/{flag_key}
